name: Malegaon
registryBasis: Maharashtra’s official RTI organization chart lists the District Superintendent of Land Records, Nashik No. 2 at Malegaon. The state Land Records Department describes the city-survey/property-card and map functions, and the official Malegaon Municipal Corporation site identifies the local planning authority. Together these establish a local land-record office/function; they do not establish a safe public geometry endpoint.
